documentation: Key/value backend for `mhl serve mcp --http` durable state (sessions + run checkpoints). One JSON file per key, mirrored under `dir`.

properties.name: dir
properties.documentation: Filesystem root for the store. Ephemeral temp dir when omitted.

methods.name: get
methods.documentation: The value at key, or null when absent.

methods.name: delete
methods.documentation: Remove key. Absent key is not an error.

methods.name: list
methods.documentation: Every key with the given prefix.
